questions.question: Through the prophet Jeremiah, the LORD told Israel to be terrified by the signs in the heavens. True or false?
Through the prophet Jeremiah, the LORD told Israel not to fear the idols of the nations. Why not?

answers.text: They can do no harm and no good
They are too far away to hurt anyone
The LORD has already broken them

questions.question: The prophet Jeremiah said the LORD is the true God and eternal King. What kind of God is He?
Jeremiah called the LORD the Portion of Jacob. Why is He not like the idols of the nations?

answers.text: He is the Maker of all things
